items.quote: that's exactly where our growth opportunities lie. I've learned that feedback is crucial for improving our productivity and success.
items.statement: Feedback is crucial for improving productivity and success.

items.quote: That's why I always ask my clients, colleagues, friends, and even my spouse for their honest feedback on my meetings, proposals, and overall performance.
items.statement: I always ask for honest feedback on my meetings, proposals, and performance.

items.quote: As part of the feedback survey, I included a similar question: "on a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate the training program?"
items.statement: Feedback questions included in the training program for sales team new joiners.

items.quote: it's important to create a culture of feedback and continuous improvement in any professional setting.
items.statement: It's important to create a culture of feedback and continuous improvement in any professional setting.

items.quote: If you're a sales professional in the real estate industry, I encourage you to try this approach and see how it can up your productivity and success.
items.statement: Encourage asking for feedback and learning from it to improve productivity and success.

items.quote: I also asked them: "If you rated anything less than 10, please help me improve myself and my program. What would make it a 10?"
items.statement: Asked participants what would make their ratings a 10 to improve his training program.

overview: LinkedIn post on the importance of feedback in meetings and training.
